name: Salt Valley
brief: Valley where David and his commanders defeated enemies
short: The Salt Valley was a location where David and his commanders defeated the Edomites and Arameans (<ref="2Sa. 8:13; 2Ki. 14:7; 1Chr. 18:12; 2Chr. 25:11; Psa. 60:1">2Sa. 8:13; 2Ki. 14:7; 1Chr. 18:12; 2Chr. 25:11; Psa. 60:1</ref>).
